shape: Dead-end ring (single south gate, perimeter loop)
description: Single-portal dead-end where the floor forms a ring around the room's interior. The spawn_south gate connects to TWO interior anchors (south-west sidhwy and NW lnjc92), each starting one arc that wraps around the room and meets at the east side. Same ring-topology primitive as ib2 but with a single gate.

portals.south: spawn_south at (-11.03, 23.29) — the only portal, on the south (high-Z) side

anchors.description: SW arc start — south arc anchor (matches sidhwy)
NW arc start — north arc anchor (matches lnjc92)

traversalNotes: DEAD-END RING: two arcs from the south gate meet at the east side. Pick either arc to explore — the autopilot's BFS will choose the shorter one to each objective.
Cross-link nw_inner ↔ sw_inner gives a shortcut between the two arcs near the west wall.
DISPATCH RULE: pick the closer arc to the objective; ring topology gives multiple paths.
